uz.title: Foizlar
uz.summary: Sonning foizini topish, foiz o‘zgarishi, ketma-ket o‘zgarishlar va dastlabki qiymatni tiklash. Bu savollarning deyarli barchasini bitta g‘oya — ko‘paytuvchi (multiplier) — bilan tez va xatosiz yechish mumkin.

sections.heading: Bu ko‘nikma nimani tekshiradi
sections.body:
Foiz — yuzdan bir ulush: $p\% = \frac{p}{100}$. SAT foizlarni uch xil ko‘rinishda so‘raydi:

- **Sonning foizi:** $x$ ning $p\%$ i $= \frac{p}{100} \cdot x$. Masalan, 240 ning $15\%$ i $= 0.15 \times 240 = 36$.
- **Foiz o‘zgarishi (percent change):** $\text{percent change} = \frac{\text{new} - \text{original}}{\text{original}} \times 100\%$. Maxrajda doim **dastlabki (eski)** qiymat turadi.
- **Ikki sonni solishtirish:** “$a$ is what percent of $b$” → $\frac{a}{b} \times 100\%$; “$a$ is $p\%$ greater than $b$” → $a = \left(1 + \frac{p}{100}\right) b$.

Eng kuchli vosita — **ko‘paytuvchi**. $p\%$ ga oshirish $\left(1 + \frac{p}{100}\right)$ ga, $p\%$ ga kamaytirish $\left(1 - \frac{p}{100}\right)$ ga ko‘paytirishni anglatadi: $20\%$ oshish — $\times 1.2$, $15\%$ chegirma — $\times 0.85$.

- Ketma-ket o‘zgarishlarda ko‘paytuvchilar **ko‘paytiriladi**, foizlar qo‘shilmaydi.
- Dastlabki qiymatni topish uchun yangi qiymat ko‘paytuvchiga **bo‘linadi**.

sections.heading: Savolni qanday tanib olasiz
items: *“What is 35% of …?”*, *“… is what percent of …?”* — sonning foizi yoki ikki sonning nisbati.
*“increased by 20%”*, *“decreased by 15%”*, *“a discount of …”*, *“a sales tax of …”* — foiz o‘zgarishi: ko‘paytuvchi bilan ishlang.
*“What was the original price?”*, *“before the discount”* — dastlabki qiymatni tiklash: yangi qiymatni ko‘paytuvchiga bo‘ling.
*“… is 60% greater than …”*, *“… is 25% less than …”* — ikki miqdorni solishtirish: “than” dan keyingi miqdor — asos (100%).
*“What was the percent increase from 2020 to 2024?”* — jadval yoki grafikdan ikki qiymatni olib foiz o‘zgarishini hisoblash; maxraj — oldingi yil qiymati.
*“percentage points”* — foiz punktlari: ikki foizning oddiy ayirmasi (pastroqda batafsil).

sections.heading: Ishlash usuli: qadamma-qadam
steps: **Asosni (100% ni) aniqlang.** “of” dan keyingi, “than” dan keyingi yoki “original” deb atalgan miqdor — asos. Foiz o‘zgarishida asos doim eski qiymat.
**Foizni o‘nli kasrga yoki ko‘paytuvchiga aylantiring:** $35\% \to 0.35$; $8\%$ oshish $\to 1.08$; $8\%$ kamayish $\to 0.92$.
**Ketma-ket o‘zgarishlarni zanjir qiling.** Har bir o‘zgarish oldingi natijaga qo‘llanadi: $x \cdot 1.2 \cdot 0.75$. Foizlarni hech qachon qo‘shmang.
**Teskari masalada bo‘ling.** “Chegirmadan keyin 323” bo‘lsa: $0.85x = 323$, ya’ni $x = 323 \div 0.85$. Yangi qiymatga teskari foizni (masalan, $15\%$ qo‘shishni) qo‘llamang.
**Foiz o‘zgarishini formula bilan hisoblang:** farqni **eski** qiymatga bo‘ling va 100 ga ko‘paytiring.

**Mantiqiy tekshiruv va format.** Oshish bo‘lsa javob kattaroq, kamayish bo‘lsa kichikroq bo‘lishi kerak. Savol javobni foiz sonida so‘rasa (*“What is the value of p?”*), javob maydoniga % belgisisiz faqat sonni yozing: **62.5**.

example.problem: The price of a jacket was increased by 20%. Later, the new price was decreased by 25%. The final price of the jacket is what percent of its original price?
solution: Dastlabki narxni $P$ deb olamiz (qulaylik uchun $P = 100$ deb ham olish mumkin).
$P = 100$ bilan tekshiruv: $100 \to 120 \to 120 - 30 = 90$ ✓. E’tibor bering: $25\%$ kamayish 100 dan emas, **120** dan hisoblanadi.

Nega boshqa variantlar xato: **95%** — foizlarni qo‘shish ($100 + 20 - 25$); **10%** — narx qanchaga **kamaygani**, savol esa yakuniy narx dastlabkining necha foizi ekanini so‘rayapti; **75%** — faqat oxirgi o‘zgarish hisobga olingan.

sections.heading: Namuna 2: dastlabki narxni tiklash (javobni o‘zingiz yozasiz)

example.problem: During a sale, a store reduced the price of a bicycle by 15%. The sale price of the bicycle was \$323. What was the original price of the bicycle, in dollars?
solution: Dastlabki narx — $x$. $15\%$ chegirmadan keyin narxning $85\%$ i qoladi: $0.85x = 323$.
Tuzoq: $323 \times 1.15 = 371.45$. Bu xato, chunki $15\%$ chegirma 323 dan emas, **dastlabki** narxdan hisoblangan. Yangi narxga $15\%$ qo‘shish dastlabki narxni tiklamaydi.

example.problem: The positive number $a$ is 60% greater than the positive number $b$. The number $b$ is what percent of $a$?
solution: “$a$ is $60\%$ greater than $b$” — bu yerda asos $b$: $a = 1.6b$.
Endi asos almashadi — $b$ ni $a$ ga bo‘lamiz: $\frac{b}{a} = \frac{b}{1.6b} = \frac{1}{1.6} = 0.625$, ya’ni $62.5\%$.

Nega boshqa variantlar xato: **40%** — $100 - 60$ dan chiqadi, asos almashgani hisobga olinmagan; **37.5%** — $b$ soni $a$ dan necha foiz **kichik** ekani ($1 - 0.625$), savol esa $b$ soni $a$ ning necha foizi ekanini so‘rayapti; **60%** — shartdagi sonni qayta yozish.

sections.heading: Nimaga e’tibor berish kerak
items: **Asos almashsa, foiz ham o‘zgaradi:** $a$ soni $b$ dan $25\%$ katta bo‘lsa, $b$ soni $a$ dan $25\%$ emas, $20\%$ kichik, chunki $\frac{1}{1.25} = 0.8$.
**Bir xil foizga oshirib-kamaytirish qiymatni qaytarmaydi:** $+10\%$ va $-10\%$ → $1.1 \times 0.9 = 0.99$, ya’ni natijada $1\%$ kamayish.
**Foiz punktlari (percentage points):** ko‘rsatkich $20\%$ dan $25\%$ ga o‘tsa, u **5 foiz punktga** oshgan, lekin nisbiy o‘sish $\frac{25 - 20}{20} = 25\%$.
**Jadval va grafikdagi foizlar:** foiz o‘zgarishi so‘ralsa, ikki qiymatni to‘g‘ri yil yoki ustundan olganingizni tekshiring; “from 2020 to 2024” da 2020 — eski qiymat.
**Yaxlitlash:** *“to the nearest whole percent”* bo‘lsa, faqat oxirgi natijani yaxlitlang.

sections.heading: Keng tarqalgan xatolar (tuzoq variantlar)
items: **Foizlarni qo‘shish:** $+20\%$ va $-25\%$ ni jami $-5\%$ deb hisoblash (namuna 1 dagi 95%).
**Teskari foiz:** dastlabki narxni topishda yangi narxga o‘sha foizni qo‘shish yoki ayirish (namuna 2 dagi 371.45).
**Noto‘g‘ri maxraj:** foiz o‘zgarishida farqni yangi qiymatga bo‘lish. 80 dan 100 ga o‘sish — $25\%$; farqni 100 ga bo‘lsangiz, $20\%$ chiqadi va u ham variantlar orasida bo‘ladi.
**To‘ldiruvchi foiz:** “necha foizi” so‘ralganda “qanchaga kamaygani”ni tanlash yoki aksincha (namuna 1 dagi 10%, namuna 3 dagi 37.5%).
**Miqdor va foizni adashtirish:** chegirma miqdorini (57) yakuniy narx o‘rniga yoki foizni miqdor o‘rniga belgilash.

sections.heading: Vaqt bo‘yicha maslahat
items: Oddiy foiz savoli: **30–60 soniya**; ketma-ket yoki teskari foiz: **60–90 soniya**.
Ko‘paytuvchi usuli eng tez yo‘l: butun zanjirni kalkulyatorda bitta ifoda sifatida yozing — masalan, $323 / 0.85$ yoki $1.2 \cdot 0.75$.
Dastlabki qiymat berilmagan bo‘lsa, uni **100** deb oling — foizlar bevosita ko‘rinadi va algebra kerak bo‘lmaydi.

Har yili bir xil foizga o‘sish (*“increases by 3% each year”*) savollarida Desmos’da $1.03^{10}$ kabi darajani hisoblang yoki $y = 500 \cdot 1.03^x$ grafigini chizib, kerakli $x$ dagi qiymatni o‘qing.

terms.meaning: foizli o‘sish / kamayish: farq ÷ eski qiymat × 100%

terms.term: percent greater than / percent less than
terms.meaning: … dan necha foiz katta / kichik: asos — “than” dan keyingi miqdor
chegirma: narx $(1 - r)$ ga ko‘paytiriladi, bunda $r$ — o‘nli kasrdagi foiz
savdo solig‘i: narx $(1 + r)$ ga ko‘paytiriladi
foiz punkti: ikki foizning oddiy ayirmasi ($20\%$ dan $25\%$ ga — 5 punkt)
